prompt.zh-TW: 小安用融資買進綠茵運動用品的股票：自己出 {{money:vars.own}}，向券商借 {{money:vars.loan}}。這筆融資借款會記在哪裡？
prompt.en: An buys Greenfield Sports shares on margin: {{money:vars.own}} of his own money plus {{money:vars.loan}} borrowed from the broker. Where is this margin loan recorded?

text.zh-TW: 記在小安的信用交易帳戶，綠茵運動用品的帳完全不受影響
text.en: In An’s margin account with the broker; Greenfield Sports’ books are not affected at all

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。股票在市場上換手，公司沒有收到錢、也沒有借錢；融資是投資人自己的負債。
feedback.en: That is right. The shares change hands in the market; the company receives no money and borrows none. The margin loan is the investor’s own liability.

text.zh-TW: 綠茵運動用品的負債增加 {{money:vars.loan}}，因為這筆錢是拿來買它的股票
text.en: Greenfield Sports’ liabilities rise by {{money:vars.loan}}, because the money was used to buy its shares

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道有人借了錢，這沒錯。但借錢的是小安，不是公司；公司的帳只記公司自己的交易。
feedback.en: You are right that someone borrowed money. But the borrower is An, not the company, and the company’s books record only the company’s own transactions.

text.zh-TW: 綠茵運動用品的股本增加，因為小安成了公司的新股東
text.en: Greenfield Sports’ share capital rises, because An has become a new shareholder in the company

feedback.zh-TW: 公司多了一位股東是事實，但那是原股東把股票賣給小安，公司沒有發行新股；股本不變。
feedback.en: The company does gain a shareholder, but an existing holder sold shares to An; the company issued no new shares, so share capital is unchanged.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_s1t2}}分清了投資人的帳和公司的帳。{{option:o_v3w4}}與{{option:o_x5y6}}都把市場上的買賣誤當成公司的交易。
explanation.en: {{option:o_s1t2}} separates the investor’s accounts from the company’s. {{option:o_v3w4}} and {{option:o_x5y6}} both mistake a market trade for a company transaction.
